39017f2580.q: What is Pacific Lawn Sprinklers business model and how many franchisees does it currently operate?
39017f2580.a: Pacific Lawn Sprinklers was founded 45 years ago by three brothers focused on the irrigation space. It began franchising in 2002 not primarily for national growth, but to incentivize employees to own their own territories. Currently, the company has 52 franchisees operating across 73 territories. The business model includes four revenue streams: irrigation installation, blowouts, breakage and maintenance, plus permanent lighting, holiday lighting, and drainage solutions—all demand-driven by franchisees who recognized cross-selling opportunities when already on customer properties.

232a0589d9.q: What is Pacific Lawn Sprinklers NPS score and how does it compare to other major brands?
232a0589d9.a: Pacific Lawn Sprinklers achieved an NPS score of 93%, which Riverside Group confirmed is the highest in their history across six different umbrella companies with almost 40 brands. For context, major companies like Apple score in the 80s, and other well-known brands typically score in the high 70s, making a 90s NPS score exceptionally rare and described as unicorn status.

103f92c075.q: What are the ideal franchise candidate characteristics and investment range for Pacific Lawn Sprinklers?
103f92c075.a: While historically owner-operators were ideal, Pacific Lawn Sprinklers now prioritizes sales and marketing professionals wanting to build an empire, plus HR-related individuals willing to engage in their community through B&I networking, local sponsorships, and customer-facing leadership. The franchisee hires irrigation technicians who only need to be handy, as the company trains them. Investment ranges from $100,000 to $150,000 with less than $100,000 going directly to the franchisor. The model is home-based requiring minimal employees—one person can generate significant revenue.

fb2f548410.q: What distinguishes Pacific Lawn Sprinklers from other irrigation franchises in the market?
fb2f548410.a: Pacific Lawn Sprinklers differentiates through a 55-person call center in New York that seamlessly manages franchisee schedules and customer appointments—unique in the franchising space. They offer optional bookkeeping services allowing franchisees to focus on sales, marketing, hiring, and staff retention. The four revenue streams reduce seasonality perception versus irrigation-only competitors. Additionally, every state is becoming stricter on water conservation, and Pacific Lawn emphasizes proper equipment and technology to manage this effectively, capabilities mom-and-pop operators typically lack.
